problems.prompt: An electric bulb draws a current of 0.25 A for 20 minutes. Calculate the amount of electric charge that flows through the circuit.
problems.attempt_hint: Formula lagane se pehle time ko seconds mein badalna zaroori hai.

solution_steps.narration: Time ko seconds mein convert karte hain.
Charge ka formula Q = I * t use karte hain.
Multiply karke final charge nikalte hain.

problems.prompt: The potential difference between the terminals of an electric heater is 60 V when it draws a current of 4 A. What current will the heater draw if the potential difference is increased to 120 V?
problems.attempt_hint: Heater wahi hai, iska matlab uski resistance (R) nahi badlegi. Pehle R nikal lo.

solution_steps.narration: Pehli condition se heater ki resistance nikalte hain.
Ab nayi voltage aur is constant resistance ko use karke naya current I2 nikalte hain.
Divide karke current find karte hain.

problems.prompt: A copper wire has diameter 0.5 mm and resistivity of 1.6 x 10^-8 ohm-m. What will be the length of this wire to make its resistance 10 ohm?
problems.attempt_hint: Diameter ko meters mein convert karke pehle area of cross-section (A = pi * r^2) nikalo.

solution_steps.narration: Diameter ko radius aur phir meters mein badalte hain.
Area of cross-section nikalte hain.
Resistivity formula R = rho * L / A ko rearrange karte hain.
Values daalkar lambai (length) nikalte hain.

problems.prompt: Three resistors of 2 ohm, 3 ohm, and 6 ohm are connected in parallel. What is their equivalent resistance?
problems.attempt_hint: Parallel ka formula lagao aur aakhir mein reciprocal karna mat bhoolna.

solution_steps.narration: Parallel combination ka formula lagate hain.
2, 3, aur 6 ka LCM 6 hota hai. Base same karte hain.
Fractions ko add karte hain.
Answer nikalne ke liye fraction ko flip (reciprocal) karte hain.

problems.prompt: Two lamps, one rated 100 W at 220 V, and the other 60 W at 220 V, are connected in parallel to electric mains supply of 220 V. What current is drawn from the line?
problems.attempt_hint: Kyunki connection parallel mein hai, voltage dono ke liye 220V rahega. I = P/V dono ke liye alag nikal kar add kar do.

solution_steps.narration: Pehli lamp ka current nikalte hain (P = VI).
Doosri lamp ka current nikalte hain.
Kyunki parallel mein hain, total current dono currents ka sum hoga.
Decimal mein convert karte hain.

problems.prompt: An electric iron consumes energy at a rate of 840 W when heating is at the maximum rate. The voltage is 220 V. What are the current and the resistance?
problems.attempt_hint: Pehle I = P/V se current nikalo, phir R = V/I se resistance.

solution_steps.narration: Current nikalne ke liye Power ka formula P = VI use karte hain.
Ab Ohm's law se resistance nikalte hain.
Values dalkar calculate karte hain.

problems.prompt: Compute the heat generated while transferring 96000 coulomb of charge in one hour through a potential difference of 50 V.
problems.attempt_hint: Time yahan zaroori nahi hai kyunki Heat done is just Work done (H = W = V * Q).

solution_steps.narration: Heat generated ka direct relationship Work done se hota hai.
Di gayi values se seedha multiply karte hain.
Total heat in Joules mil jati hai.
Scientific notation mein likhte hain.

problems.prompt: An electric refrigerator rated 400 W operates 8 hours/day. What is the cost of the energy to operate it for 30 days at Rs 3.00 per kWh?
problems.attempt_hint: Power ko kW mein badal kar total ghanto se multiply karo, phir rate se multiply karke bill nikal lo.

solution_steps.narration: Power ko kilo-watt mein convert karte hain.
Total operating hours nikalte hain.
Total Energy consumed E = P * t
Cost nikalne ke liye per unit rate se multiply karte hain.
